name: factory-flow
title: Factory flow
author: Filip Hostinský
description: Keeps a factory laid out by factorio_optimizer near its plan: a machine runs while something it makes is waited for, a machine ahead of its planned intake leaves what others behind plan wait for, and overflow belts keep their items in front of the users until a maker would stop. Works on blueprints tagged with tools/factory-flow/tag.py; install it before building the blueprint.
